[Why teams bring me in]{.dm-eyebrow}

## I bridge what analysts need and what IT can support

My background runs through physics, electrical engineering, field work in Alaska's oil fields, and years of energy consulting, with plenty of IT along the way.
That mix lets me translate between what analysts and data scientists want to do, what the tools can actually do, and what IT will allow.
Then I find a path that works for all three.
:::

::: {.dm-points}
- **I see the whole picture.** I look at the workflow around a task, not just the task.
- **I'm proactive.** You'll hear about risks and opportunities early, not after they've cost you.
- **I communicate clearly.** I explain things plainly to analysts, IT, managers, and clients.
- **I help you work smarter.** I stay current on tools and bring practical shortcuts that make a team faster.
:::
